title: Historical Family 003 retuning to 0.8749570194201
description: Historical contribution by Troy Winarski (TheRealDubb), pinned at b6c98187528e036b8c60414a6961ef999caf31fb. The proof retunes OpenAI Family 003 geometry and proves nonvanishing for every Dirichlet character to the right of 8749570194201/10000000000000, excluding the principal pole; the source also covers zeta and finite-order Eisenstein Hecke targets. The 189 imported proof modules retain their original declaration namespaces and proof terms, with tracker import paths relocated. TheRealDubb granted Apache-2.0 permission for his additions and modifications in those 189 modules, to the extent of rights he holds (permission recorded in the PR #113 discussion). Upstream OpenAI/math and Mathlib material retains its original notices and licenses. Only those 189 modules are imported; archive helpers, fixtures, and dependencies are excluded. Public announcement is dated by the first source-history commit carrying this exact bound: b6c98187528e036b8c60414a6961ef999caf31fb, committed at 2026-10-10T03:35:40Z (author and committer timestamps agree). This records the source commit time, not a separately observed public push time. The historical directory retains the same UTC calendar date. The author's Windows receipt reports statement, axiom, and Lean-kernel checks; tracker admission and Linux production replay remain pending.
